During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], '''Brann Lo-Farr''' owned a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]]. When [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] tried to take the [[Lower Deck]] cantina for himself after the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], some of Lo-Farr's former comrades alerted the [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] [[Bespin Wing Guard/Legends|Wing Guard]]. They were able to stop Jabba, as well as pay off the rest of Lo-Farr's mortgage on the Lower Deck cantina.
